description: This PHP source file defines the 'DefinedNames' class for reading and processing named ranges and expressions from an ODS spreadsheet, part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's ODS reader.

classes.name: DefinedNames
classes.description: A class for reading and processing defined names (named ranges and expressions) in an ODS spreadsheet.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Orchestrates reading of defined ranges and expressions from the workbook data XML.

methods.name: readDefinedRanges
methods.description: Reads named ranges (defined names) from the spreadsheet XML data.

methods.name: readDefinedExpressions
methods.description: Reads named expressions (formulas) from the spreadsheet XML data.

methods.name: addDefinedName
methods.description: Adds a defined name to the internal spreadsheet structure, associating a name with a worksheet and value.
